description: This file is a shell script used for testing various features and behaviors of a Git repository, particularly focusing on sparse checkout and sparse index functionalities. It includes test setups, command executions, and verification steps for operations such as checkout, reset, diff, status, and more, often in combination with sparse checkout configurations.

methods.name: init_repos
methods.description: Initializes multiple repositories in different states, setting up sparse checkout configurations and creating various branches and commits for testing purposes.

methods.name: init_repos_as_submodules
methods.description: Initializes repositories and adds submodules for testing submodule handling with sparse checkout.

methods.name: run_on_sparse
methods.description: Executes a given command in the sparse-checkout and sparse-index directories, capturing output and errors.

methods.name: run_on_all
methods.description: Runs a given command in all repositories (full-checkout, sparse-checkout, sparse-index).

methods.name: test_all_match
methods.description: Executes a command in all repositories and verifies that outputs match expected results.

methods.name: test_sparse_match
methods.description: Executes a command in all repositories and verifies that outputs match, or that commands fail as expected.

methods.name: test_sparse_unstaged
methods.description: Checks that unstaged diffs for a given file in sparse repositories are empty.

methods.name: test_sparse_checkout_set
methods.description: Sets sparse checkout cone and sparse index configurations and verifies the internal state of the index regarding sparse directories.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, running the given commands.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that the given command must fail.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Checks if the specified path is missing in the working directory.

methods.name: test_path_exists
methods.description: Checks if the specified path exists in the working directory.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or outputs for equality.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern in a file or output.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Ensures that the given output or file is empty.

methods.name: test_region
methods.description: Checks if a specific region of a trace report matches expectations.

methods.name: test_write_lines
methods.description: Writes lines to a file, used for scripting interactions.

methods.name: write_script
methods.description: Defines a shell script to be used as a helper command during tests.
